title: Урок 11: Проект уровня Beginner — Консольный Todo-менеджер

content_blocks.content: Консольное приложение для управления задачами с командами:

todo_cli/
├── Cargo.toml
├── src/
│   ├── main.rs
│   ├── lib.rs
│   ├── models/
│   │   ├── mod.rs
│   │   └── task.rs
│   ├── storage/
│   │   ├── mod.rs
│   │   └── json_storage.rs
│   └── commands/
│       ├── mod.rs
│       ├── add.rs
│       ├── list.rs
│       ├── done.rs
│       └── remove.rs

[package]
name = "todo_cli"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0"
anyhow = "1.0"
clap = { version = "4.4", features = ["derive"] }

> add "Learn Rust"
Added task: [○] 1: Learn Rust (2024-01-15 10:30)

> add "Build a project"
Added task: [○] 2: Build a project (2024-01-15 10:31)

> list
[○] 1: Learn Rust (2024-01-15 10:30)
[○] 2: Build a project (2024-01-15 10:31)

> done 1
Task 1 marked as done

> list
[✓] 1: Learn Rust (2024-01-15 10:30)
[○] 2: Build a project (2024-01-15 10:31)

> remove 2
Task 2 removed

> quit
Goodbye!

items: **Тесты**: написать unit-тесты для storage и commands
Ownership, move, clone, references, borrowing rules, slices, lifetimes
Traits, generics, associated types, `impl Trait`, `dyn Trait`
